blockers: tests/test-deployment-controller-v0612-upgrade-state.py must provide the retained historical .21 endpoint to its isolated shell harness, or the function must receive it explicitly, without weakening production lock loading.

issues.title: Historical v0.6.12 harness omits required endpoint variable
issues.details: preflight.sh verify_helm_release_state dereferences EXPECTED_CLUSTER_SERVER, but the isolated historical harness does not define it, so set -u aborts before revision assertions.
